definitions.gloss: feeding wild animals or birds; taming by feeding
definitions.explanation: The act of regularly providing food to wild animals or birds, either to tame them or as a habitual practice. Can also refer to training animals to come to a specific location through feeding.

examples.japanese: {鳩|はと}に{餌付|えづ}けをする。
{公園|こうえん}での{野良猫|のらねこ}への{餌付|えづ}けは{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Feeding stray cats in the park is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {観光客|かんこうきゃく}による{野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}への{餌付|えづ}けが{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Feeding of wild animals by tourists has become a problem.

notes:
Composed of {餌|え} (bait/feed) + {付|つ}け (attaching/applying). Refers to regularly feeding wild animals, often to tame them or attract them to a location.

USAGE:
Used as a する verb: {餌付|えづ}けする. The object is marked with に or への: {鳩|はと}に{餌付|えづ}けする (to feed pigeons).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餌付|えづ}け{禁止|きんし}: no feeding (common sign in parks)
- {野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}への{餌付|えづ}け: feeding wild animals
- {餌付|えづ}けする: to feed (wild animals)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In many Japanese parks and nature reserves, {餌付|えづ}け is prohibited because it disrupts animals' natural behavior and can make them dependent on humans. Signs reading {餌付|えづ}け{禁止|きんし} are common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {餌|えさ}やり: feeding (more general, including pets)
- {給餌|きゅうじ}: feeding (technical/formal)
